## Purpose

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands actually executed and their results. Explain relevant limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `main`; changes are focused and ready for production.
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Relevant lint, build, and available tests pass.
- [ ] Code follows AGENTS.md, including modularity and the 250-line rule.
- [ ] Documentation reflects approved changes; no secrets or sensitive evidence included.
- [ ] Breaking changes, risks, and any manual steps are described.
